translations.web: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.’
translations.bsb: Keep My Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’
translations.kjv: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the LORD your God.
